_comment: Canonical response payloads for the Desk Remote API.
The server builds these with pydantic models (server/main.py) and the app
decodes them into kotlinx.serialization data classes (data/Models.kt). The
two sets of field names are written by hand and nothing else connects them,
so both test suites assert against this file: rename a field on one side
without the other and CI fails instead of the app silently showing stale
